fields.why: The brief says a single case or case series takes outcome_types 'from the counts or measures reported', but this two-patient report gives only clinical course (treatment failure, ~80% improvement), so [] and binary/categorical are both defensible. A rule saying whether per-patient clinical outcomes with no counts earn a type would decide it.
For data_focus limited, the brief states that a single case or descriptive case series takes analytic_depth 'summary'; B's empty list departs from that explicit rule.

brief_issues: Case reports with no counts: brief prescribes depth 'summary' but leaves outcome_types open; align the two (e.g. type of the clinical outcome described).
